messages:
Olivia - Events: quick heads-up — switching segment order: product roadmap will go at 11:05 instead of 11:20. Also seeing captions flapping on encoder A. Need someone to monitor captions + start a local backup recording just in case.

Alex R.: ok, moving roadmap up works for me. who wants captions? @Jordan (SRE) did you see anything in the logs?

Jordan (SRE): saw encoder process OOM around 11:00, attached snippet: `E: encoder process killed: out_of_memory (libavcodec)` — pushing a spare encoder now (ec2-enc-02). will update routing in a minute.

Sam L.: if captions fail we can flip to a browser-based fallback (Rev.ai) and screen-share the captions. quick fallback steps in case:
1) start local OBS recording
2) switch encoder to x264 in settings
3) open captions tab (rev.ai) and share window
I can take this if nobody else can.

captions-bot: Caption service (rev-ai) health -> degraded (latency > 2s). Automatic failover not configured.

Olivia - Events: Sam — please take captions then, thanks. Alex can you confirm local recording path? I'll update the slides cue and prod lead ping.

Alex R.: on it. starting local recording now. saving to /mnt/recordings/allhands/1867543210.mp4. will post when done.

Jordan (SRE): ec2-enc-02 up, route updated. pushing ffmpeg to origin to catch the stream:
```
ffmpeg -i rtmp://origin/stream -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 3500k -c:a aac -f hls /var/www/hls/stream.m3u8
```
Watching CPU & mem.

Maya P.: quick leadership Q for roadmap segment — can we include one slide that calls out Dedicated SLA improvements and one with an estimated Private deployment timeline? i'll ask for clarity during the Q&A.

Olivia - Events: noted, Maya — i'll ask product to condense to 2 bullets each.

Alex R.: adding a 2-min Q&A buffer after roadmap to handle follow-ups. @captions-bot once Rev recovers can you re-enable auto captions? :thumbsup:

captions-bot: Rev.ai recovery detected at 11:12. Auto-captioning re-enabled. Latency normal.

Jordan (SRE): encoder mem stabilized after route change. recording + stream look stable from my side, continuing to monitor.

Sam L.: seeing captions in preview, looks good. Olivia — sending the shortened prod slide to you now.

Olivia - Events: awesome — thanks so much. calling this resolved unless anything else pops. heading live in ~3m. :rocket:
